newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: G10 sees no inflation concern - Tietmeyer.
newsitem.headline: G10 sees no inflation concern - Tietmeyer.

text.p: Bundesbank President Hans Tietmeyer said Group of 10 central bank governors saw no new reason for concern about inflation.
Tietmeyer also said after the monthly meeting of G10 central bank governors that their economies overall were showing signs of increasing growth.
"We have looked at the inflation situation. There seems to be, according to the available information, no new reason for concern," Tietmeyer told reporters in his capacity as chairman of the group.
Tietmeyer said central bankers would always be vigilant about inflationary potential. "The inflation outlook seems to be all in all positive," he added.
Tietmeyer said the G10 central bank governors, meeting at the Basle-based Bank for International Settlements, also talked about the state of their real economies.
"All in all, we came to the assessment that there is a positive development in most countries on the way as far as growth," he said.
Tietmeyer said growth was strong in some countries and weaker in others, but he did not elaborate.
"But in most countries it is going in the direction of increasing growth rates, not very strong but in the direction of increasing growth," he said.
